system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant for Microsoft Teams workspace tasks.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Clone a team (members only), notify all members, and post in General.

prompts.prompt_text: Hi, I'm Alice Johnson (the project manager in the team "TechCorp Solutions Team", with team_id: team_techcorp_001). Please replicate the "TechCorp Solutions Team" as "TechCorp Solutions Team v2", keeping only its members. Also, let's send a short activity notification to all its members saying: "Welcome to TechCorp Solutions Team v2! Let's get started". Finally, post a message in the General channel of "TechCorp Solutions Team" saying "Hi @here, we're creating a new version of this team"

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT t1.display_name AS original_team, t2.display_name AS cloned_team FROM teams t1 INNER JOIN teams t2 ON t1.visibility = t2.visibility WHERE t1.display_name = 'TechCorp Solutions Team' AND t2.display_name = 'TechCorp Solutions Team v2' AND t1.team_id <> t2.team_id ) result
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM activity_notifications WHERE preview_text_content LIKE 'Welcome to TechCorp Solutions Team v2! Let%' AND preview_text_content LIKE '%get started'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM channel_messages WHERE team_id = 'team_techcorp_001' AND json_extract(body_json, '$.content') LIKE 'Hi @here, we%' AND json_extract(body_json, '$.content') LIKE '%new version of this team'
